district_name: Bellows Falls Union High School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Bellows Falls Union High School District (District No. 27), a union high school district in the Windham Northeast Supervisory Union (member districts Athens Grafton, Rockingham and Westminster).
Bellows Falls Union High School (official school website); board materials post to the Windham Northeast SU document portal.

board.org_name: Bellows Falls Union High School Board

sources.note: Bellows Falls Union High School District annual-meeting warning (board-approved February 16, 2026, in the June 8, 2026 board agenda packet): the signature block lists all ten directors with term-end years -- Chris Hodsden (Chair), Jamie Storrow, June Streeter, Kim Keefe, Mary Howard Hall, Paul Obuchowski, Ginger Driscoll, Emily Bragonier, Ben Wallace, Emily Ferenc. Directors are elected by their member districts, not at the union meeting (16 V.S.A. section 706k(a)); the March 9, 2026 board minutes list the same ten in attendance. The current per-town allocation of the ten seats could not be re-verified (the last full allocation on record is 2020: Rockingham 5, Westminster 3, Grafton 1, Athens 1; only Bragonier = Westminster is confirmed current), so the board is modeled as one ten-seat post.
